about: Synthetic dealership CRM lead view. Every issue below is planted on purpose; the test checks that each part-1 issue is caught.

planted.issue: Heading jumps from level 1 to level 4
Two elements share the id a label points to. axe reports this as needs review, not a failure.
Field with no label at all
Placeholder is the only label. axe accepts it; it disappears once someone starts typing.

planted.where: lead temperature dots (lead header, My leads list)
planted.issue: Hot, warm and cold shown by color alone. axe passes this; the usability layer should flag it.

Text on a gradient, from clearly readable (the dark send line) to borderline (the eyebrow, the headline's light end, the fine print). axe can't measure text on a gradient, so judges decide each piece, and on the borderline ones they can split. It's there so the review threshold has something to move.
